observations: I opened and looked at assets/panels/04-3.png, the cast sheets and page-04.png. Ananya matches the sheet: almond eyes with heavy upper lids, level brows, an oval face with a pointed chin, a low bun, a gold stud, teal kurta, white coat and a stethoscope around her neck that is not in use. She faces screen right toward Ravi, keeping the direction set in 04-1.
Her gentle closed-mouth smile, steady eye contact and small nod marks fit 'listens with attention'. The scene supports the caption's point that the conversation stays human.

Her hands are folded on the desk with all fingers resolved. I could not tell confidently from the overlap and wrist paths which hand is on top (the record says right over left), so this is unverified rather than wrong.
The closed laptop sits at the lower-left edge of the desk, matching the prop record. The pen cup and folder on the shelf carry no readable text. A pothos is on the window sill.
Ravi is added as a foreground over-the-shoulder shape on the right: dark hair, beard edge and green shirt. This matches the 'head' record and is a framing supplement.
